name: com.aethernexus.foundationplatform
description:
Stop rebuilding project plumbing. Free AetherNexus foundation for Unity 6: EventBus, DebugX console logging, owned CoroutineX, TweenX/Feedback (no DOTween), Identity/patterns, AetherInspector, and shared editor utilities — no GameEngineCore required.

Requires Unity 6000.3.10f1+. URP recommended. Depends on Input System and uGUI.

Embeds Cysharp UniTask 2.5.11 (MIT) under Runtime/ThirdParty/UniTask and Editor/ThirdParty/UniTask. Asset uses UniTask under the MIT license; see Third-Party Notices.txt in the package for details.

Optional leaf for GameEngineCore and other AetherNexus packages - sold separately.

samples.description: Play Mode demo: owned CoroutineX ladder publishes SamplePingEvent; EventBus subscriber logs via DebugX. Requires Input System (Active Input Handling). Domain Reload should stay enabled.
